notes.title: Update notes for version 1,5.4
notes.content:
• Fixed bug that would cause black balls to spawn in at the wrong size
• Fixed a bug where collision would not apply to balls that were near the edge of the canvas

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.5
notes.content: We've just released a new update for DrawBall! This update contains various quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes  and new rewards for players who achieve all 3 stars on the title screen!
